items.explanation: ラ is the katakana for 'ra', the same sound as hiragana ら. It is the same light tap of the tongue as ら.
items.mnemonic: A rabbit's ear (the short top line) over its hunched back.
items.culture_note: ラ developed from the kanji 良.

items.explanation: リ is the katakana for 'ri', the same sound as hiragana り.
items.mnemonic: The two reeds of り, standing straighter.
items.culture_note: リ developed from the kanji 利. リモコン is another clipped loanword: remo(te) con(trol).

items.explanation: ル is the katakana for 'ru', the same sound as hiragana る.
items.mnemonic: Two roots growing down, one with a kink at the end.
items.culture_note: ル developed from the kanji 流. ビール comes from the Dutch bier, another word from the centuries of trade with the Netherlands.

items.explanation: レ is the katakana for 're', the same sound as hiragana れ.
items.mnemonic: The leg raise from れ: one straight leg kicking up.
items.culture_note: レ developed from the kanji 礼.

items.explanation: ロ is the katakana for 'ro', the same sound as hiragana ろ. It looks like the kanji 口 (mouth), but in katakana words it is ロ; context tells them apart.
items.mnemonic: A square robot head, and ロボット (robotto) means robot.
items.culture_note: ロ developed from the kanji 呂.
